title: Do Sparse Autoencoders Identify Reasoning Features in Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sparse autoencoders (SAEs) using theoretical analysis of L1-regularized decoding, combined with causal token injection and LLM-guided counterexample generation, to demonstrate that the sparsity objective systematically favors low-dimensional linguistic correlates (token-level cues) over genuine, high-dimensional reasoning computations.
